title: Auto-Doser Reagent Runway
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs (e.g. Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=doser:event
| stats latest(container_ml) as remaining, avg(daily_ml) as usage by reagent
| eval days_left=round(remaining/usage,1)
| where days_left<7
| sort days_left
description: Estimates how many days of each dosing reagent remain so a reef's chemistry never lapses because a bottle ran dry.
value: Coral growth depends on steady dosing; a reagent runway means you refill before a gap stalls or harms the reef.
implementation: Ingest doser events into `index=personal`; schedule daily and flag reagents running low.
visualization: Table of dosing reagents by days of supply remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It works out how many days of the special reef chemicals are left, so you refill before the tank goes without.
